text: In June 2025, most of what we repeated was the title of a bill. Twenty-two of us said "and related agencies"; twenty-one said "military construction veterans affairs," first said by Lisa Murkowski; twenty said "and related agencies appropriations," also first said by Lisa Murkowski; nineteen carried "and related agencies appropriations act," first said by Chuck Grassley. On June 25 those phrases peaked together. Earlier, on June 12, twenty-eight of us said "9 4 billion" and nineteen said "waste fraud and abuse." That is the record: a spending figure and a spending complaint on one day, and the long name of an appropriations act on another. We were reading the same lines. We note it here without deciding what it meant.
